sources.use: Single-factor passwords: minimum 15; permit at least 64; count Unicode code points, avoid composition rules, and check a blocklist. Email proof here confirms a contact and does not authenticate a session.
Generic registration errors/responses and work-factor timing precautions; existing-account handling cannot disclose arbitrary contact ownership.
Reuse framework IdentityV3 password hashing with explicitly owner-approved work factor. Test iteration count is isolated and not a production choice.

font_resolution: Reuse existing @tunner/ui pinned @fontsource-variable/geist 5.3.0 and inter 5.3.0 local bundles. Initial temporary upstream font downloads were removed; no duplicate runtime font system or package version introduced.
technology_decision: No new external technology/provider choice. Reuse existing framework protection, policy/calendar, EF/Identity/outbox and shared UI. Source guidance remains engineering guidance, not legal age/consent authority.
